m. (-पः)
1 An arrow.
2 Confusing, disturbing, (the ideas.)
n. (-पं)
A hole, a vacuity, a chasm.
E.
रुप to disturb, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what plants, raises, &c.
m. (-कः)
A weight of metal or a coin, the seventieth part of a Suvarṇa.
E.
रुह to rise, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.

A disturbing or bewildering of the mind, a confusing, or confusion of ideas.
4 Cicatrizing, healing.
5 A healing application to sores or wounds.
E.
रुह to ascend, causal v., or रुप to bewilder, aff. ल्युट्.

Raised, elevated. Bewildered, perplexed.
E.
रुह to rise, causal v., or रुप to bewilder, क्त aff.
